title: Acceptance probability of an always rejecting tester
statement: For any nonnegative integers $d,r$ and any function $f:\{0,1\}^d\to\mathbb F_2$, the tester that always rejects has acceptance probability $0$ on $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the binary cube of dimension $d$ to $\mathbb F_2$
